question: Which of the following was the aim of Liberalisation under New Economic Policy 1991 of India?

options.text: To put embargo on enemy countries trade.
To increase restrictions on economic activities.
To open various sector of the economy.
To increase non-tariff barrier on Imports.

solution:
The correct answer is __**To open various sectors of the economy**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Liberalisation** under the **New Economic Policy (1991)** aimed to reduce government control over the economy and encourage private sector participation. The goal was to make the economy more globally competitive. 
• The policy involved removing excessive **restrictions, licenses, and quotas**, enabling businesses to function more freely without extensive bureaucratic interference. 
• The liberalisation measures focused on **opening various sectors** to foreign investment, encouraging private companies, and eliminating trade barriers such as excessive tariffs and import restrictions. 
• The **Industrial Policy Resolution of 1991** reduced the number of industries requiring compulsory licensing and allowed private participation in sectors previously reserved for the public sector.
